caveats: All 16 paired BOLOS firmware ELFs (8 Baseline + 8 Candidate A) and the 6-cycle counterbalanced A/A + ABBA/BAAB Speculos benchmark (`t7_abba.py run --out /tmp/t7-abba-run1 --cycles 6 --cores 2,3 --wait-timeout 600 --max-load 2.0`) were executed on VM Boat large (`managed-9656beea-c385-43e6-a24d-36b69ebb6168`, 8 vCPU / 16 GiB RAM, snapshot `ledger-hub-warm-v1`). All 16 `app.elf` SHA-256 digests built on VM Boat large match bit-for-bit the 16 `app.elf` from the earlier local `ashur` build in `/tmp/opencode/t7-a-bolos-builds/{baseline,candidate-a}` (128/128 ELF/stack/insn fields identical between VM Boat large `elf_comparison.json` and `ashur` `elf_comparison.json`; auxiliary `app.map` and `app.apdu` fields in `storage_ram_stack` come from the `ashur` build directory).

Candidate A replaces 3 occurrences of `decide (x ≠ 0)` with `bnot (decide (x = 0))` in `BitcoinLedger/FreestandingKernels.lean` (`llbFormatSatsAscii` / `llb_format_sats_ascii`), eliminating 3 redundant `ite` branches in Lean IR and LLVM IR. Standalone freestanding `.text` deltas: `-632 B` `thumbv6m.o`, `-496 B` `thumbv8m.main.o`, `-592 B` `riscv32imac.o`, `-4620 B` `x86_64.o` under `clang-21` (and `-596 B`, `-530 B`, `-626 B`, `-5238 B` under `clang-18` in `/tmp/opencode/t7-a-boat-harvest/validation_manifest.json`).

Build provenance: Baseline ELFs were built from `lean-ledger-bitcoin` commit `f68864d1f2af8fd9f2ca26acddb5f0abd3e80bcb` (`BitcoinLedger/FreestandingKernels.lean` SHA-256 `bfc26b0ab178aa76735bbf01d06621d67e04bfd2d2de16ad6f99f8f0859f67f7`). Candidate A ELFs were built by applying `candidate.patch` (SHA-256 `77996b8d3bb47cd5619a5a2b2e6affca61fc8a5506755c5b14f502b5dd3a6662`) to `f68864d1f2af8fd9f2ca26acddb5f0abd3e80bcb`, yielding `BitcoinLedger/FreestandingKernels.lean` SHA-256 `593076bd3c5aa554584aa736396cd19ad012a05af6277d058c2708eec9cf9290` (identical to worktree `t7-fable-a` commit `6518e152d7fe3a9af980714ced46c536e4090bf3`, with `Tests/T7FormatSatsEquivalence.lean` and `Tests.lean` updated in the working tree so `lake build Tests` builds all 45 targets with 0 `sorryAx`).

Static firmware ELF deltas (Candidate A minus Baseline, verified across all 8 variant pairs): Nano S+ (`thumbv8m.main`) `-228 B` `.text` across all 4 variants, `-79` emitted Thumb instructions (`-3` in `format_sats_amount` wrapper, plus LTO inlining of `fracSigLen` and `copyTicker` and outlined-function changes), `-512 B` `load_flash_bytes` on `nanosp-testnet-perf` (`0 B` on mainnet/testnet due to page alignment), `0 B` `.bss` RAM (`6232 B` mainnet/testnet, `6200 B` perf), `0 B` worst-case stack (`12496 B`), `0 B` `format_sats_amount` max stack (`124 B`); Nano X (`thumbv6m`) `-256 B` `load_flash_bytes` across all 4 variants, `-270 B` `.text`, `-89` emitted Thumb instructions (`-3` in `format_sats_amount`), `0 B` `.bss` RAM (`4068 B` mainnet/testnet, `4036 B` perf), `0 B` worst-case stack (`11248 B`), `+8 B` on `format_sats_amount` call-subtree `max_stack_bytes` (`132 -> 140 B`, still `-128 B` below C reference `268 B`, originating from `llb_format_sats_ascii` own frame `sub sp, #0x20 -> #0x28` after LTO inlines `fracSigLen` and `copyTicker`, while C wrapper `format_sats_amount` own frame stays `40 B`).

Before the dynamic run, the 4 `testnet-perf` ELFs (`A-nanosp.elf`, `B-nanosp.elf`, `A-nanox.elf`, `B-nanox.elf`) were copied read-only and SHA-256 hashed in `manifest.json` (`manifest_sha256`: `3609e054b6f59c46ff9fb1a13d678e1af2fb293e896c2aa02d055f759de14e67`, recorded 11s before the first sample in `samples.jsonl`, self-declared by `t7_abba.py`). ELF section `ledger.api_level` is `27` in all 4 ELFs (`runtime_api_observed: false`).

Dynamic 6-cycle A/A + ABBA/BAAB Speculos benchmark on VM Boat large (`affinity: [2, 3]`, `exclusive_reservation: false`, `load1` range `0.44..2.30`, 672 samples total, 7 samples marked `contaminated` in A/A Nano X cycle 4 pos 0): empirical Speculos wall-clock noise is high (CV 8–44%, A/A identical-binary median deltas `-10.7%` to `+14.2%`). Two A/B cells on non-formatter scenarios (`GET_MASTER_FINGERPRINT` Nano S+ `+16.5%` median and `GET_VERSION` Nano X `+18.1%` mean) exceed the A/A range due to emulator noise; no paired cycle difference is statistically significant (`|t| <= 1.61` over 6 cycles). This run only rules out runtime regressions larger than ~10–15% on `testnet-perf` and claims NO runtime speedup.
Candidate C1 (Vanadium `TrackingHeap` feature gate) was stopped cleanly and not retained because `common/src/errors.rs` lacks an explicit protocol error variant for disabled `GetHeapStats`.
